y-m-82-02.goal: Zvionere kuti mutemo wakagadzirwa kubva pamadata mashoma ekutanga unoedzwa sei nedata itsva, uye utaure kuti humbowo hupi nezviito zvinotevera zvinodiwa kuti 'usimbise' mutemo.
y-m-82-02.material:
Isa mapoinzi n pa denderedzwa uye ubatanidze peya imwe neimwe yemapoinzi nechikamu chemutsetse. Sarudza mapoinzi kuti pasave nezvikamu zvitatu zvinosangana papoinzi imwe (semuenzaniso, ma diagonals e regular hexagon haakodzeri, nekuti matatu anosangana pakati). Ngatitii R(n) i huwandu hwema regions anopatsanurwa nezvikamu izvi mukati medenderedzwa.
Kune vasingagone kuona mufananidzo, heino tsananguro mumashoko. Kana n=3, triangle imwe inoumbwa, ine region 1 mukati metriangle nema regions 3 kunze kwetriangle, saka R(3)=4.
